rationale: A wins because it finds the cleanest, most grounded product story in the update: "Eight Sleep's mattress cover now reacts to snoring by changing the bed's temperature." B inexplicably refuses that lane as "Feature mechanics with no protagonist" and replaces it with "Snoring detection lands in the biohacker bed before it lands in the sleep clinic," which starts importing CPAP incumbents and category power-balance drama the update did not give us. A is sharper because its four protagonists are genuinely different: product mechanism, regulator, paying owner, clinic.
gaps_in_A: "detects snoring or a low SpO2 reading overnight and changes its own temperature in response" slightly overstates the mechanism unless Eight Sleep can prove temperature changes are triggered by both signals, not just adjusted automatically alongside sensing.

"existing owner being asked to pay again" is a strong paywall frame, but it depends on proof that existing covers physically contain the sensors; A does flag this, but the angle leans on it before verification.
The clinic-study angle is honest, but "whether its data means anything" needs an investigator or protocol fast; without that, it is still more sidebar than story.
gaps_in_B: "Snoring detection lands in the biohacker bed before it lands in the sleep clinic" is too cute and not grounded; the update says a sleep clinic study is ongoing, so the 'before the clinic' contrast is muddy at best.

"where CPAP makers and home sleep-test vendors own the snoring-and-oxygen territory" imports a competitive landscape not supplied in the update. That is exactly how an angle gets dressed up past the facts.
"it isn't cleared to say the word" overreaches. The update says wellness, not FDA-cleared diagnostics; it does not establish what words Eight Sleep can or cannot use.

Refusing "Why the automatic temperature adjustment is a breakthrough for sleep quality" as "Feature mechanics with no protagonist" throws away the most concrete launch-day mechanism. The fix was to make the bed's closed-loop behavior the protagonist, which A did.
